name: Alchemy FM Channel Designer
author: MMagTech
description: Design live radio channels in AudioMuse using CLAP, lyrics, mood clusters, and Song Alchemy — preview programming, then deploy to Alchemy FM.

versions.changelog: Fix Design Full Station doing nothing. The new action was handled inside a branch gated to preview/push/chat_preview, so the button never reached its handler. It is now dispatched correctly, and drafting no longer requires a valid Step 2 first - which was the point, since you use it when the form is still empty.

Journeys now support every endpoint find_path allows - start from a seed track or a Song Alchemy anchor, finish on a mood, track or anchor, with a mood_pct dial for how far toward a centroid the path travels. Daypart gains an optional mood arc layered on the energy curve, using the mood tags AudioMuse already returns. The Chat Designer gains a second button, Design Full Station, which turns one sentence into a draft of Steps 1, 2 and 5 using AudioMuse's own configured AI - entirely optional, every value validated against the form's own choices, and it never deploys. Settings page restyled to match the designer.
